visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens at an outdoor fish pond on an overcast day. A woman wearing a white t-shirt, black pants, and a red cap holds a large, silver-scaled fish vertically on a scale. She is smiling broadly. (2) Close-up shot of the fish's side, highlighting its large, individual scales and the metallic lure hooked in its mouth. The fish is thick and powerful-looking. (3) The woman is seen from a medium-full shot standing on the concrete edge of the pond, holding a black fishing rod. She wears a beige jacket over her shirt. She begins reeling in the line. (4) Multiple fast-cut shots follow, showing the woman without her jacket, standing on the bank and fighting a fish. Her body weight is shifted back as the rod bends significantly. She is laughing and moving her head excitedly. (5) The camera pans to the water surface where a large fish is splashing vigorously, creating white foam. An excavator is visible in the distant background across the pond. (6) The woman successfully lands the fish. She is seen kneeling on the ground, holding the massive fish horizontally with both hands. She looks towards the camera with a triumphant expression. (7) Final sequence shows her in different poses with various large fish she caught, including a very large one that she holds up while kneeling on the ground. (8) The video ends with a graphic outro featuring a circular frame with her photo surrounded by autumn leaves and social media icons.
